question: Who joined the Competition Commission of India (CCI) as Chairperson on 23rd May, 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ravneet Kaur**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ravneet Kaur** joined the Competition Commission of India (CCI) as Chairperson on 23rd May, 2023.
 
• She has a significant role in overseeing fair trade practices in the market and ensuring that businesses comply with competition laws.
 
• Her appointment is crucial for maintaining and promoting healthy competition in various sectors of the economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Competition Commission of India (CCI) is a statutory body of the Government of India responsible for enforcing The Competition Act, 2002 throughout India.
 
• The CCI aims to prevent activities that have an adverse effect on competition in India.
 
• Its objective is to promote and sustain competition in markets, protect the interests of consumers, and ensure freedom of trade.
 
• The Chairperson of CCI plays a pivotal role in steering the commission's efforts towards achieving these goals.
